items.html: And we will now explain the matter of these aspects in ZA of Atzilut. Behold, the Nukva has three garments, called her body (Gufa de-Ila), and each garment comprises ten Sefirot, as above. But ZA — in each of these three garments that he has there are only nine Sefirot (Tet Sefirot), for Malchut completes him to ten Sefirot. Remember this rule. Hence it is found that the body of ZA is only three garments, each one comprised of nine Sefirot, which are in all twenty-seven levels.
